As the BOX skin (SPEC 5.11: the phone's Box skin on every level): a gen_board.curtain_crate(10, 3) scratch render over L50 (135) reads as the same obstacle but visibly different. The corner studs are missing. The slab has dark vertical side shading and a dark bottom band, where the phone has a flat violet face with a light top bevel. The lug caps are big and flare outward (the phone's are short stubs). The generator scales the sphere with min(w, h)/3, but on the phone the sphere stays about 2.3-2.9 cells on every box size (L53 4x4, L56 10x9, L57 20x12). So a 10x9 box would get a huge sphere. The manifest still describes the V1 video 'curtain' (confirmed false).
entries.fix: Rebuild as the phone BOX: a flat violet slab with a light top edge and 4 corner studs (0.4-0.5 pitch in from each corner). Keep the sphere at a FIXED ~2.4-cell size (cap sc at ~1), with short lugs and the navy well inside a purple ring. Add boxW<w>H<h> entries for the sizes the levels use (3x3, 3x4, 4x3, 3x5, 5x3, 4x4, 10x3, 10x9, 20x12), and re-point the manifest purpose and ref at shots 135 / 154 / 174 / 179.
